We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR? Probably we need to get 1H NMR spectrum and count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (requires SMILES?). The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra takes no parameters? It says returns 1H NMR spectra for a given SMILES string, but no input. Possibly the system has a sample at hand (the compound). So calling without parameters will give the spectrum. Then we can count methyl peaks (singlet around 0.9 ppm etc). Could also use carbon_nmr_spectra to see methyl carbon signals (~10-30 ppm). Simpler: get proton NMR and count number of methyl groups (distinct CH3 signals). But methyl groups could be overlapping. Might need HSQC to correlate. But likely simple.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
